decisions.rationale: No cp312 binary wheel for mujoco 2.3.7; conda not available on Colab. mujoco 3.3.2 has binary wheel and is confirmed stable for LIBERO in upstream issues.
mujoco 3.x removed mj_step1. One call in LIBERO uses it for reset speed-up. hasattr shim is backward-compatible with 2.x and forward-compatible with 3.x.

decisions.decision: Pin numpy>=1.24,<2 LAST in Step 3 + pin opencv<4.10
decisions.rationale: opencv 4.10+ requires numpy>=2, which breaks torch 2.2.0 (compiled against numpy 1.x). Moving numpy pin last prevents any subsequent install from upgrading it. opencv<4.10 avoids the conflict entirely.
flash-attn 2.5.x has no cp312 wheel. cp312 support added in 2.6.x. flash-attn 2.6.3 has no cu121 wheel but cu118 runs on CUDA 12.x via forward compatibility.

decisions.decision: Check numpy version via subprocess pip-show, not import
decisions.rationale: torch (imported in Cell 2) caches numpy 2.0.2 in sys.modules. After pip force-reinstall, 'import numpy' returns the cached 2.0.2 not the disk 1.26.4. subprocess pip-show reads disk version accurately.
